the owner RATIFIED 2026-09-07. BOTH candidates were BUILT and GATED on the real 236-tip panel, not estimated: Gordonia margin -5.9 (~88 nt) PASS; Kitasatospora setae NR_112082.2 margin +0.6 (~9 nt) BOUNDARY-pass, and -1.0 on the pre-build estimate - i.e. indistinguishable from zero either way. Gordonia is PRIMARY for publication because a root that survives by under one percentage point is not one to defend in review. K. setae is RETAINED as the family-consistent comparison (refpkg <workspace>/_PLACEMENT/bees_Kitasatospora_OG/) so the pair can be shown together, which is the arrangement the owner approved for the cohort trees. WHY Kitasatospora is weak here: at 16S it is barely separable from Streptomyces, and the SPECIES matters more than the genus - K. albolonga measures 99.9%/1452nt to a panel member, an ingroup member in all but name.

2026-09-29 ALEX RULING (supersedes the 2026-09-08 Pseudomonas row): root rare-genera 16S trees on Bifidobacterium bifidum KCTC 3202 (T), NR_044771.1, an outgroup inside the phylum (Actinomycetota) but outside every ingroup order. The accession is written into outgroup_species_strain so get_16s fetches it by accession, not by a name-based pick. WHY: the Pseudomonas root showed the long-branch attraction its own row warned of. On a 117-type-strain 16S backbone (RAxML-NG GTR+I+G, 1,000 bootstraps) it joined next to Saccharothrix, making that genus sister to all other genera with two Saccharothrix type strains as a basal grade. Rebuilt on the same backbone with B. bifidum, Saccharothrix is one clade (bootstrap 100) among the Pseudonocardiales genera, and tree_sanity_check passes with the outgroup drawn. ISOLATION, measured on the same alignment (outgroup_sanity_gate.py, ungapped shared columns): nearest ingroup member 86.3% over 1471 nt (NR_074617.1) against the ingroup's most isolated member 91.1% over 1460 nt (NR_119354.1), 4.8 points outside = PASS (Pseudomonas on its own alignment: 13.0 points outside). RESIDUAL RISK: the outgroup branch is still long (about 0.96 subs/site); pruned, the Nocardiopsis stem dominates, so draw the outgroup as a labelled tip. Pseudomonas aeruginosa DSM 50071 (NR_026078.1) remains usable as a comparison root. 16S phylogeny is not taxonomy: Pseudonocardiales is not monophyletic on this backbone.
